description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    Prerequisite: 3 semesters of applied study on major performance instrument.

Co-requisite: 2 hours of applied study on major performance instrument.

A pass/fail course for students to demonstrate proficiency on their major performing instrument. Students demonstrate technical and musical performance proficiency by performing a solo/etude, major and minor scales as well as sight reading.
    
</section>
